items.source: Return the configured message size limit.
items.translation: 返回configured消息大小限制。

items.source: hints - additional information about how to do decode
items.translation: hints - 关于如何进行解码的附加信息

items.source: Flux deserialized via decode(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map) are expected to use delimited Protobuf messages with the size of each message specified before the message itself. Single values deserialized via decodeToMono(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map) are expected to use regular Protobuf message format (without the size prepended before the message).
items.translation: 通过 `decode(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map)` 反序列化的 Flux 预期使用定长 Protobuf 消息，每条消息的大小在消息本身之前指定。通过 `decodeToMono(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map)` 反序列化的单个值预期使用常规 Protobuf 消息格式（不在消息前附加大小）。

items.source: This decoder requires Protobuf 3 or higher, and supports "application/x-protobuf" and "application/octet-stream" with the official "com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java" library.
items.translation: 此解码器需要 Protobuf 3 或更高版本，并支持使用官方 `"com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java"` 库处理 `"application/x-protobuf"` 和 `"application/octet-stream"`。

items.source: Notice that default instance of Protobuf message produces empty byte array, so Mono.just(Msg.getDefaultInstance()) sent over the network will be deserialized as an empty Mono.
items.translation: 注意，Protobuf 消息的默认实例会产生一个空字节数组，因此通过网络发送的 `Mono.just(Msg.getDefaultInstance())` 将被反序列化为一个空的 `Mono`。

items.source: Return the list of MIME types supported by this Decoder. The list may not apply to every possible target element type and calls to this method should typically be guarded via canDecode(elementType, null). The list may also exclude MIME types supported only for a specific element type. Alternatively, use Decoder.getDecodableMimeTypes(ResolvableType) for a more precise list.
